question: Should Signal permanently support per-account `apiMode` overrides while native existing-server setup proves daemon/RPC reachability and container setup additionally proves linked-account receive readiness?
rationale: Both policies can be implemented correctly, but this choice defines persisted configuration, upgrade behavior, and the operator-facing readiness guarantee.

options.title: Accept expanded contract
options.body: Keep per-account overrides and document and verify the intentionally different native and container readiness guarantees.

options.title: Keep channel-global mode
options.body: Land the wizard and diagnostics while retaining the existing channel-level transport-selection contract.

options.title: Pause the broad feature
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a narrower permanent Signal setup and readiness policy.

recommendation.title: Accept expanded contract
recommendation.body: Keep per-account overrides and document and verify the intentionally different native and container readiness guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest merged history across every central Signal surface involved in this choice.
